verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Forter publishes a live llms.txt at docs.forter.com (HTTP 200). It contains a structured index of documentation pages served as Markdown (.md) URLs, which an agent can be pointed at directly. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent evidence of agents consuming the llms.txt successfully, and evidence of fuller agent-oriented guidance beyond the index (e.g., an llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage docs).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
